topics.title: Why a cheaper lead vendor can raise your cost per booked job
topics.text: Owners switch vendors to cut cost per lead, then booked jobs drop. The cheaper list was full of dead leads, so every booked job cost more.

topics.title: New patient cost looks fine until you count no-shows
topics.text: Practices celebrate a low cost per new patient lead. Count the leads that never showed and the real number moves.
